items.description: The tidal River Yare from Thorpe St Andrew to Breydon Water
items.message: High water levels today, Friday 13 November may lead to flooding.  Flooding is possible from 12 noon to 3pm on, Friday 13 November.  We expect to see high water levels in Brundall and Reedham riverside areas. Levels can take several hours to peak. We are not expecting the situation to escalate, or to issue any further warning messages at this time. We are closely monitoring the situation. Avoid coastal roads and low lying roads near rivers, which may be flooded. This message will be updated by 10am Saturday 14 November, or as the situation changes.
